scope: Static local source, distributed fixtures and rebuilt Windows executable. Recognizable pattern matches reviewed in context; not a guarantee of absence of unknown secrets or an institution publication authorization.
fixtures: Seven synthetic document inputs and two synthetic OCR inputs retained without changing their bytes from the inspected source release.
guide: Updated one-page guide matches current review-list PDF / XLSX / CSV features; no Page 1 label.
publicValidationArtifacts: Only current generic test/build/audit summaries are included. Historical reports, user-supplied document fingerprints and metadata, demo evidence, and private inspection artifacts are excluded.
recordScope: Local pre-publication baseline before the Windows append-only log fix. Published binaries are identified by the release SHA256SUMS and the corresponding GitHub Actions run.
